question: If sin θ + ((1)/(4)) cosec θ = 1 and 0 ≤ θ ≤ 90°, then find the value of θ.
solution:
**Given:**

sinθ + ((1)/(4)) cosecθ = 1

**Concept used:**

cosecθ = 1/sinθ 

(a - b)2 = a² + b² - 2ab

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc116d26b92d04e13dc77acded25f436fa82e69fd412bed9c969ed5d9be8905b.png] 

**Calculation:**

sinθ + ((1)/(4)) cosecθ = 1

⇒ sinθ + ((1)/(4× sinθ)) = 1

⇒ sinθ + ((1)/( 4sinθ)) = 1

⇒ ((4sin²θ+1)/( 4sinθ)) = 1

⇒ 4sin²θ + 1 = 4sinθ

⇒ 4sin2θ + 1 - 4sinθ = 0

⇒ (2sinθ)² + 1² - 2 × 2sinθ × 1 = 0

⇒ (2sinθ - 1)² = 0

⇒ 2sinθ - 1 = 0

⇒ 2sinθ = 1

⇒ sinθ = 1/2

⇒ sinθ = sin30°

So, θ = 30°

**∴ The value of θ is 30°.**
